subject: Kickoff: Cross-channel activation for ByteForge Summit (May)
messages:
From: Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>
Cc: Tessa Morgan <tessa@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 14 Mar 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Kickoff: Cross-channel activation for ByteForge Summit (May)

Hi team,

Following our quick sync last week, ByteForge (Helena Cruz) has come back with a tentative invite to participate in their May Summit in Seattle. They are proposing: a 30-minute breakout, a shared demo booth, and a co-authored blog post to promote the session.

Attached: summit_proposal_v1.pdf — high-level ask from ByteForge.

Primary goals:
- Drive 200 targeted demos/registers for Redwood features integrated with ByteForge (embedding pipeline demo)
- Capture joint lead list for follow-up (we own nurture)
- Produce a short co-authored post + social push the week of the event

Asks from our side:
1) Who can lead the breakout content?
2) Can we commit a customer speaker for a 10-minute panel? (Tessa can help identify candidates)
3) Logistics owner for booth operations and budget confirmation

I recommend Marcus own logistics/partner ops, Camila lead content/storyboarding, and Tessa handle customer seat/CS coordination. If that sounds right, I will loop in Helena and push on timelines & MAP.

Thanks — Priya

--
Priya Natarajan
Head of Alliances, Redwood Inference
priya@redwood.com
+1 415-555-0142

From: Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>
Cc: Tessa Morgan <tessa@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 15 Mar 2027 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Kickoff: Cross-channel activation for ByteForge Summit (May)

Thanks Priya — I like the ask. A couple of quick thoughts:

- Format: instead of a straight 30-minute talk, propose "lightning demo + customer panel" (15/15). Short demos convert better at these summits.
- Content: focus on integration story + measurable outcome (embedding cost per query improvement / latency).
- Audience play: push to their ML engineering list and our product newsletter the week before; coordinate social assets for co-scheduling.

I've attached a rough panel_topic_outline.docx with tentative themes and a proposed customer order.

Agree on role split — Marcus on logistics, I can draft the session narrative and slides. Tessa, can you flag 2 customers who are ok with public speaking (ideally on dedicated or private deployment)?

Camila

--
Camila Reyes
Director, Developer Marketing, Redwood Inference
camila@redwood.com

From: Helena Cruz <helena@byteforge.com>

Subject: Re: Kickoff: Cross-channel activation for ByteForge Summit (May)

Hi Priya / Camila / Marcus — great to meet you all (virtually). Thanks for the quick turnaround. Short answers: yes, yes, and yes.

ByteForge can commit to:
- Shared booth (cost split 50/50)
- 30-minute breakout slot (we are open to the 15/15 format you suggested)
- Co-authored blog with cross-promotion across our channels

I looped Sanjay (EdgeConsulting) — they are our integration partner and can provide a customer for the panel if needed. Lisa from DevForum is our media partner and will help amplify social.

Attached: byteforge_brand_assets.zip (logo, colors, speaker bios).

Availability note: Helena is out Mar 22-25, but we can lock speaker names and a MAP before the end of March. Proposed next steps:
1) Mutual Action Plan (MAP) with deadlines for creative, speaker confirmation, registration landing page
2) Speaker confirmations by Mar 24
3) Shared promotion calendar + asset drop by Apr 8

Helena — can you confirm the electronics available at the booth (screen size, network)? Marcus, will you own logistics details?

Best,
Helena

Helena Cruz
Head of Ecosystem, ByteForge
helena@byteforge.com

- Budget: please confirm shared-cost line items (booth, furniture, monitor rental, swag).

I've started a MAP template (mutual_action_plan.xlsx) and populated milestone dates per Helena's timelines. Priya — I'll drop the HubSpot partner play link once I tidy it up: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/123456/company/78910

Helena / Sanjay — can you confirm the consulting speaker and provide a 250-word speaker bio by Mar 22? That will lock the promo CTA.

Marcus
